features.title: FastAPI/React skeleton with OIDC auth and CAD geometry service
acceptance: FastAPI app starts and serves health endpoint
SQLite persistence with models for CAD parts and unfold operations
Docker compose with backend, frontend, Keycloak, and volumes

features.title: Sheet-metal unfolding engine (cadgen.unfold)
acceptance: Thickness detection from parallel planar face pairs
Bend detection from coaxial cylindrical faces
Flange tree construction and layout into XY plane
Bend allowance calculation (K-factor and bend table)
Unfolded output with profile, bend lines, and bend records
Refusal for hems, curls, conical bends, variable thickness, collisions

features.title: Viewport region selection for agent context
acceptance: Selected geometry exported as agent context

features.title: Large STEP model loading with streaming/memory management
acceptance: Progressive loading for large STEP files
Memory envelope enforcement with graceful degradation
